decisions.reason: Locates cordis.patch.yml:5-6, patch.yml:2-6 target src/session/view/SessionView.ts and apply-patch.mjs; explicitly distinguishes composition rows from the real patch declaration and explains the private session-view coupling under A1-03.

Locates the legacy/informational-note producer with ignorable:true at src/index.ts:17, explains alpha.1 removal and alpha.2 restoration, concludes the marker must be preserved (corridor folding), rejects consumer whitelists, and correctly notes public Session.append has no ignorable parameter.

Locates ctx.get('apiProxy') with session.rename and llm.providers at src/index.ts:25-32, maps removal to A1-01, distinguishes Host domain injection (ctx.llm.listProviders) from Client-side ctx.remote and explicitly warns against inject:['remote'] on the Host plane.
Locates homedir()/.dsh/profiles/default at src/index.ts:35-38, explains the write bypasses runtime DSH_HOME and selected profile per A1-04, and does not claim --profile was new in alpha.1.

Locates both the private SessionView import from @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-view/internal (line 10) and ctx.contributes.registerCommand('legacy.openView') (lines 41-43), and explains owner-by-owner public-seam verification after the A1-03 split without inventing new paths.

Locates the raw Node loopback HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:43121 (lines 47-53), explains loopback does not exempt it from auth, and distinguishes Connection-gated official /api routes from raw routes needing explicit gate wiring per A1-08.

Locates both dsh headless spawn (src/index.ts:57-67) and execFileSync JSON.parse (apply-patch.mjs:12-19), correctly states stdout was already final text so the JSONL assumption is a pre-existing error, and identifies alpha.1's stderr reasoning segment as the corridor change without inventing a stdout change.
Complete grounded mapping: #1/#5 to A1-03, #2 to A1-02+A2-01 with corridor folding, #3 to A1-01, #4 to A1-04, #6 to A1-08, #7 to A1-05; each mapping is tied to located lines, not a bare card list.

Accounts for all seven categories as hits, rules out narrower surfaces with negative evidence, states scan and runtime limits, and proposes build/typecheck baseline, isolated cold boot and a core functional path as future validation without executing the fixture.
